observations.summary: main README is only title plus 'Multi-faceted reasoning repo'
r47 is 278 commits ahead of main and 0 behind, adding extensive docs, source, state, and tests
supplemental branch contains detailed foundation and candidate runtime spine

claims.proposition: Rezon main alone is sufficient to reconstruct the implemented or researched Rezon architecture visible in the repository portfolio.
claims.rationale: Main contains only a minimal README while the supplemental lineage contains hundreds of commits of architecture, source, tests, and state.
claims.claim_ceiling: Repository-observation finding; does not select a canonical current non-main branch.

claims.proposition: The audited r47 continuation branch is the current canonical Rezon state.
claims.rationale: The branch is materially richer than main, but the audit also observed many later work and qualification branches and did not retrieve an authoritative canonical-current pointer binding r47 as current.
claims.claim_ceiling: Currentness unresolved; no newest-branch or richest-branch inference.

claims.proposition: Rezon main and the r47 continuation branch differ materially in documented and implemented state.
claims.rationale: Exact compare and root/file reads show a 278-commit delta with extensive added implementation and documentation.
claims.claim_ceiling: Difference only; not currentness or quality.

limitations: This case intentionally refuses to infer canonical currentness from branch recency or branch richness.
